text:
Hannah (People Ops): Heads up — planning a one-week 'Honor Circuit' mobile spot-award run across SF & NYC offices next month. Need volunteers, kit owners, and a short checklist. Budget estimate $1k. Who can help? :party_parrot:

Ajay: dates? is this during Tuesday–Friday or spread across weekdays?

Hannah (People Ops): Thinking Mon 4/11 — Fri 4/15. One office per day, midday pop-ups (11:30–2:00) so devs can swing by between meetings.

Sam: I can take SF day (Mon). happy to run the table and hand out stickers/certificates.

Toni: I can cover NYC Wed. Do we have the printed certs? also need a lockbox for spot-award envelopes.

Hannah (People Ops): Good — printing plan: we'll use the office printer but need a template + plastic sleeves. Ajay can you make a quick cert template? Also we should use QR codes for digital nominations.

Ajay: Yep. I made a simple template — one-line recognition, date, signer. Putting it in Drive: https://drive.redwood/ops/honor-circuit/template.pdf

Sam: For QR→redemption flow, I'd prefer a short URL. We can use the internal form and a short code. Example QR payload:
```
https://forms.redwood.in/spot-award?code=HONOR2026
```

PeopleOpsBot: Calendar events created: "Honor Circuit — SF (Mon), Remote RSVP" and "Honor Circuit — NYC (Wed)". Pinged #office-resources for table booking.

Toni: Volunteers: SF: Sam; NYC: me; Downtown MTL? (I can ask Jules). Also need swag list — stickers, lapel pins, confetti packs?

Hannah (People Ops): Swag plan: stickers, 50 lapel pins, 100 small thank-you cards, envelopes for spot awards, sticky name tags. I'll order through procurement (code PO-OPS-2026). Can volunteers confirm headcount by Friday 3/22.

Ajay: I'll do cert PDF + a print run checklist. Suggestion: carry a small receipt book and have a budget owner sign each award.

Sam: I'll bring the branded marker and scotch tape. Also request a small card reader for on-the-spot donations (optional).

Hannah (People Ops): Awesome. Final asks:
- volunteers confirm by 3/22
- Toni/Jules confirm NYC turnout estimate
- Ajay upload certs and printing checklist
- I'll place swag order by 3/24

Toni: Confirmed for NYC estimate ~40 people peak. I can pick up pins locally.

Sam: SF estimate ~35. Confirmed volunteer.

Hannah (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll send a short runbook this week with times, contacts, and a volunteer rota. :sparkles:

Ajay: +1. If anyone wants to practice the 30s pitch for handing out awards, LMK.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder set for 3/22 to collect volunteer confirmations.
